heroHeadline: Russia Orders Closure of German Consulate in St. Petersburg as Leipzig Drone Fallout Escalates
heroSubtitle: Russia's Foreign Ministry announced it will close the German Consulate General in St. Petersburg by September 18 and reaffirmed the closure of Goethe-Institut cultural centers in Moscow, St. Petersburg and Yekaterinburg by September 9 — direct retaliation for Germany's September 2 closure of the Russian consulate in Bonn and the Russian House in Berlin over the Leipzig/Halle Airport drone attack. Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov called Berlin's attribution of the attack to Russia 'an effective declaration of war against us'; Russia continues to deny involvement. It follows the September 1 discovery of an explosive-laden drone in a Vaslui County field, safely detonated by Romania's Intelligence Service, and Polish F-16 intercepts of Russian Il-20 reconnaissance flights near Łeba (Aug 31) and Ustka (Sep 3).
